title: Excel by material, edge banding defaults, drawer cross pieces
notes: Excel cut list with four tabs: By module (as before), By material and By material and thickness — in these two, identical pieces (same name, size, material,…
Edge banding defaults: carcass sides and drawer sides one long and one short edge, applied (outside) backs all four edges, inside backs none, stretchers one…
Wooden drawer boxes: front and back are the same piece, “Drawer cross piece”, Qty 2 per drawer, the same height as the sides; the bottom is nested between…
Cut list, Excel and manual show the module name without the size.
Existing modules: Rebuild them to pick up the drawer and stretcher changes.
